headline.en: Find suspicious instructions in the files agents read.
headline.zh: 在 Agent 阅读的文件中找出可疑指令。

sub.en: AgentGuard scans local project and dependency text, extracts prose units and applies explicit instruction-pattern rules.
sub.zh: AgentGuard 扫描本地项目与依赖文本，提取 prose 单元，并应用明确指令模式规则。

body.en: Findings preserve source file and line.
body.zh: 结果保留源文件和行号。

body.en: Rule explanations expose the trigger phrase.
body.zh: 规则解释展示触发模式。

body.en: Severity and configured rules determine exit status.
body.zh: 级别和配置规则共同决定退出状态。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Create a temporary complete README with one suspicious sentence and ordinary documentation, then run the production scan pipeline.
note.zh: 创建含一条可疑句子与普通文档的完整临时 README，运行生产扫描链路。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Production file walk, prose extraction and rule scan on a temporary synthetic README. The suspicious sentence is inert text and is never executed.

body.en: Create a temporary complete README with one suspicious sentence and ordinary documentation, then run the production scan pipeline.
body.zh: 创建含一条可疑句子与普通文档的完整临时 README，运行生产扫描链路。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentguard-ts.git
cd agentguard-ts
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: This is heuristic text detection, not proof that a package is malicious or that a clean package is safe.
limitations.zh: 这是启发式文本检测，不证明包恶意，也不证明无发现包安全。

limitations.en: Changing rule severity can change the CI result. Inspect project overrides when interpreting a clean status.
limitations.zh: 修改规则级别会改变 CI 结果；解释无发现状态时应检查项目覆盖设置。

limitations.en: The demo scans one synthetic README and never executes its suspicious sentence.
limitations.zh: 示例扫描一份合成 README，不执行其中可疑句子。

body.en: Comments, documentation and fixtures can contain text addressed to an assistant. A scan that keeps source type and location gives a reviewer a concrete sentence to inspect.
body.zh: 注释、文档和 fixture 可能含有面向助手的文本。保留来源类型与位置的扫描可以让检查者定位具体句子。

body.en: walk enumerates files, extract reads comments, Markdown, YAML and supported tool-description text, and rules combines suspicious verbs with addressee patterns. scanner applies project overrides and report groups findings by severity. HIGH findings set a nonzero scan status.
body.zh: walk 枚举文件，extract 提取注释、Markdown、YAML 与支持的工具描述，rules 组合可疑动词和收件人模式。scanner 应用项目覆盖设置，report 按级别汇总；HIGH 发现设置非零扫描状态。

body.en: walk enumerates files, extract reads comments, Markdown, YAML and supported tool-description text, and rules combines suspicious verbs with addressee patterns. scanner applies project overrides and report groups findings by severity. HIGH findings set a nonzero scan status.
body.zh: walk 枚举文件，extract 提取注释、Markdown、YAML 与支持的工具描述，rules 组合可疑动词和收件人模式。scanner 应用项目覆盖设置，report 按级别汇总；HIGH 发现设置非零扫描状态。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: The CLI defaults to scanning project files and dependencies; --no-deps excludes dependencies. .agentguard.yaml can disable rules or override severities. An explicit --config path must be readable and valid; --rules selects another signature file.
body.zh: CLI 默认扫描项目与依赖，--no-deps 排除依赖。.agentguard.yaml 可禁用规则或覆盖级别。显式 --config 路径必须可读且有效，--rules 可指定其他签名文件。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js scan . --no-deps
node dist/cli.js scan . --json
node dist/cli.js scan . --ci
